limitations: This adjudication was produced by one model and has not received human or inter-rater review.
Equivalence judgments are task-specific and assess concrete security obligations rather than general conceptual similarity.
Some corpus records overlap or differ mainly in scope, so another qualified evaluator may reasonably classify a small number of borderline equivalents differently.
The frozen silver labels remain model-generated reference judgments rather than authoritative ground truth.
Coverage-gap statements from the selector were available as context but were not treated as evidence that a required control was covered.
